commands.command: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e

notes: JavaScript unit tests run with `npm run test:unit`; full JavaScript validation runs unit tests and browser E2E with `npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e`.
The separate Python proxy suite is `uv run --no-project --with-requirements proxy/requirements.txt --with pytest --python 3.11 env PYTHONPATH=proxy pytest tests/proxy -q`.
